rows: June 30, 2026 · USD · Search for unrecorded liabilities workpapers
DRAFT FOR THE CPA · audit procedures · not an audit report · no opinion expressed

Sound Ridge Mechanical’s pay application 7 (SRM-2604-07) is for HVAC work in place on Pier 9 from June 1 to 30, 2026, certified July 3, received July 9, 2026 and booked in July; it was paid on August 8. Proposed: debit job cost $186,400.00, credit accounts payable $177,080.00 and retainage payable $9,320.00. The machine never posts.

Pellham & Quist LLP’s invoice 2026-0712 of July 12, 2026, $23,480.00, is for legal work from May 4 to June 30, 2026: the Corliss lien and the subcontract form review. It was unpaid at October 15 and nothing was accrued. Proposed: debit general and administrative expense, credit accrued liabilities.

The utilities accrual of $6,200.00 was May’s yard and office bill and left out temporary site power. June’s bills were $15,640.00. Proposed: debit job and office costs, credit accrued liabilities, $9,440.00. Under clearly trivial alone; listed because it repeats each month.

June’s interest, $17,040.00 on the term loan and $11,625.00 on the line, was debited by the bank on July 1 and recorded in July. Accrued interest at June 30 is nil. Proposed: debit interest expense, credit 2410 accrued interest, $28,665.00. The quarterly review found the same practice (interest recorded when paid).

UL-01 adds $186,400.00 to Pier 9 Tech Center’s cost at June 30. Revenue is cost-to-cost, so the same correction would add $204,835.16 of revenue and reduce the overbilling: a net $18,435.16 increase in income. The CPA settles it together with the job schedule testing’s CO-07 finding before posting either.
Materiality is proposed at $340,000.00, 0.5% of the year’s revenue, with performance materiality $255,000.00 and clearly trivial $17,000.00. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.
No management representation letter has been obtained. It should state that all liabilities, including those for work done before June 30 and billed later, are recorded.
These are draft workpapers and a draft findings memo for the engagement partner. They are not an audit report and give no opinion. Nothing has been signed, posted or sent.
